newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Kent cut by Smith Barney.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Kent cut by Smith Barney.

text.p: -- Smith Barney said analyst Ann Schwetje reduced Kent Electronics Corp to neutral from buy.
-- said a second round of EPS revisions due to weakness in the semiconductor equipment customer base "is the catalyst prompting the downgrade."
-- said she cut the earnings estimates to $1.11 per share from $1.35 for 1997, ending in March, and to $1.25 from $1.60 for 1998.
-- also cited "shift in investor perception from a...high growth story to one that has had two successive earnings disappointments announced."
-- believes this perception "will take quite a long time to repair."
-- sees stock's fair value at $14-$15. Shares dropped 5-1/8 to 16-1/4.
